verdict.rationale: Ramp's spend-controls docs define Funds as budgets with amount, interval, allowed merchant categories, allowed merchants and allowed countries, and cards carry these controls. Marketing says Ramp will "block risky merchants or categories all before spend happens", and pricing lists "auto-lock cards when compliance is unmet", which covers both restriction and point-of-sale enforcement. Missing for 10: technical documentation of how authorization-time declines work (e.g., decline reasons, real-time auth behavior), and independent or hands-on corroboration that out-of-policy swipes are actually blocked.
